scope: Second bounded China operator pass: resolve Beijing No6/C18 campus locator and revisit China Mobile Shaoguan C/D coordinate-system blocker. Earlier published source files remain unchanged.

normalized_action.site_name: China Mobile International Information Port, Beijing
normalized_action.name: China Mobile Beijing International Information Port No6 / C18 Data Center Development

status.summary: Official supervision procurement candidate notice dated September 1 confirms the No6/C18 development. Two planned data-center buildings plus associated power buildings are one project at the existing campus. Procurement and scheduled service dates do not establish physical works or a government construction permission.

locator.precision: Representative marker inside the existing mapped Phase3 sector of China Mobile International Information Port. Locates the wider named campus only; it does not locate No6/C18, a new data-center building, a parcel boundary, or the full-campus centroid.
locator.identity_review: Official No6/C18 notices identify China Mobile International Information Port in Changping at the North Sixth Ring / Badaling Expressway junction. OSM way768393624 is explicitly named China Mobile International Information Port Phase3; the operator contact page corroborates Phase3 at Manbai Road, Shahe, Changping. Point is the arithmetic bounding-box center of that polygon and is verified inside it. The May26 official design notice says southeast C18 whereas July9/September1 official notices say northeast; neither direction is resolved by this marker. OSM Phase6 is not asserted to be No6 parcel.
locator.uncertainty_reason: Community mapping gives no measured positional accuracy. Offset from the existing Phase3 marker to No6/C18 is unknown; numeric precision is arithmetic/source precision, not survey accuracy.

normalized_action.distinctness_review: Reviewed 419 projects, 395 sites and all 231 original imported records. No Beijing/Changping/International Information Port project or source alias occurs. Existing CN records are Haidong Phase2, Shaotang Shaoguan and Guizhou B5/B6. Nearest existing site is LG Uplus Paju AIDC, 945.43km away. No6/C18 is one development within one campus; phases mapped in OSM are not extra projects or sites.
normalized_action.successor_review: Reviewed official September1 procurement notice and project registration on October13. A later September9 supervision award is indexed in secondary mirrors but its primary page was not recovered; it would remain procurement evidence. No verified later physical start, completion, operation, cancellation or granted development/building permit found. OSM commercial/construction tags and version dates are not lifecycle evidence.

scoped_project_details.planned_building_scope: Two data-center buildings, two power-center buildings and basement; outdoor works included.
scoped_project_details.floor_area_rounding_note: May design notice 99,270sqm differs from rounded July registration 99,300sqm; no actual completed area inferred.
scoped_project_details.status_date_scope: Dated procurement public notice; not first announcement or construction observation.

ready.evidence_review: Fresh primary procurement record September1 is 42 days before review. Existing-campus locator is intentionally broader than the No6 project. Two proposed data-center buildings stay one development, not two counted sites.

holds.name: China Mobile Shaoguan C and D buildings, maintenance and switching buildings
holds.hold_reason: Official September30 plan image recovered and visually read. Pre-approval notice does not establish a granted planning permission or construction. Numeric projected X/Y coordinates are printed for C and D buildings, but coordinate reference system/datum is absent from displayed plan; do not silently assume CGCS2000 versus a legacy Chinese system.
holds.next_evidence: Recover same-parcel cadastral/architectural drawing with explicit CRS, or primary exact-campus longitude/latitude. Then use September30 announced stage unless later genuine permission/works evidence is recovered.
holds.location_identity: ZC0201A-15 parcel in Shaoguan Zhenjiang data-center cluster; proposed C and D buildings are distinct from A/B explicitly marked Phase1 already built in the official plan.

geometry_research.axis_interpretation: Source labels X and Y; numeric pattern suggests northing/easting with zone prefix, but specific CRS not established. No decimal-degree transformation or admission performed.
geometry_research.plan_assertion: Four requested buildings: C, D, maintenance building and switching building; public notice period September30-October10. A/B expressly marked phase1 built.

holds.second_pass_resolution: Re-fetched the official September30 pre-approval page and full-resolution plan in this batch. Searches for an explicit CRS for this exact parcel found no binding statement. A different city logistics parcel drawing mentions CGCS2000 but cannot establish this project CRS. An OSM search found a China Mobile city office, not this data-center campus, and was rejected. No transformed geographic point is supplied.
holds.search_scope: Exact project/parcel plus coordinate/CRS searches; same project plan inspection; named OSM campus search. Unchanged broad-source retries stopped.

followup_corrections.correction: The southeast-versus-northeast C18 wording conflict exists between primary official notices, not only in a secondary mirror. Official May26 design correction says southeast; July9 registration and September1 supervision candidates say northeast. All agree on the same International Information Port / C18 project. No exact C18 parcel locator is claimed.

geometry_derivation.method: componentwise min/max midpoint, verified inside source ring by ray casting
geometry_derivation.mapping_vs_project_identity: This is Phase3 of the existing named campus, not the No6 parcel. OSM Phase6 way901858374 separately reviewed; no primary crosswalk from Phase6 to C18 found, so no identity equivalence asserted.

search_limits: Nominatim exact Chinese/English campus queries returned no matches; Overpass endpoints returned406/timed out. Known OSM way IDs discovered via Mapcarta and then fetched directly from the primary OSM API.
Secondary September9 award was not used to set status. No service schedule date used as physical-start date.
Source plans and registered areas are forecasts/scope, not completed capacity; IT power remains unknown.
